stationary_kernel_check.scope: Held-signal packets with arbitrary anchors; independent stationary process and correlated Gaussian update. This does not establish exact FOH packet noise or flight performance.

limits: Opt-in prototype; useSquareRootCovariance defaults to false. Full-P disabled controls match exactly, but state storage grows 55192 bytes even when disabled.
Generic QR costs roughly 23–26 times filter CPU and 9–16 times total replay component CPU; host timings are descriptive, not target WCET.

All scored factors and dense diagnostic matrices are positive definite in these cases. This does not establish robustness to arbitrary inputs or every initialization, recovery, reseed and IMU-dropout path.
Legacy optical-flow drift remains large. Root covariance addresses numerical representation, not measurement-model errors or statistical consistency.
The prior approximate Simpson process-noise model remains unchanged; shared endpoint FOH correlations are not exact.
Dense covariance remains for diagnostics and auxiliary terrain/barometer logic. ESKF.State constructors now require root and representation fields.
Main estimator and correction exported fresh. Unchanged preintegration/predictor/queue objects reused from the owned prior study; shared kernel source byte equality checked before linking.
Native filters were not rerun. Frozen native comparison is on identical captures and transport, with measurement-noise floors and range/height/source policies still unequal.
The composed fusion-horizon model still has the previously recorded Rumoca boundary. The benchmark schedules the four generated components explicitly.
No full CI, target hardware or flight qualification claimed.
status: Broad goal active. End-to-end root prototype validated on the paired matrix; production optimization and native fidelity gaps remain.
storage: Owned bounded temporary outputs used because $HOME/scratch is read-only in this session. Durable review evidence is in the repository.
